user.title: instnt hub
user.description: Connects Home Assistant to the instnt hub app. Anything that can be found (PlayStation Network, ps5-mqtt) is filled in right away; choose the rest under Configure.

abort.already_configured: instnt hub is already set up.

init.title: Connections and automations
init.description: Choose which devices belong to the companion. The automations are off by default: if you already have your own automations for the same thing, turn those off first, or they will run twice.

data.keep_on: Keep the TV on while these play
data.auto_tv: TV off when the console turns off

data_description.console_power: The ps5-mqtt switch (instant), or the PlayStation Network media player (cloud, about 30 seconds later).
data_description.soundbar_toggle: A script or button that toggles the soundbar, for example through a Harmony Hub.
data_description.keep_on: Pick the Apple TV itself, not a HomePod in the same room.
data_description.guide: Fetches an XMLTV guide every six hours for the app. By default the free Dutch file from open-epg.com.
data_description.guide_channels: Empty = the main Dutch channels. The list appears once the guide has been fetched.
